title: Korea in January: Winter Festivals and Safety Tips
summary: Planning a Korea trip in January? Learn how to check ice festival conditions, when to visit Hwacheon, and where to see winter lights in Seoul.

slides.title: Ice Festivals Can Cancel
slides.voice: Korea in January: ice festivals can cancel. Check conditions.
slides.photo_query: Hwacheon Sancheoneo Ice Festival ice fishing Korea

slides.title: Confirm The Ice
slides.sub: Check official updates a few days ahead
slides.voice: Check the official site a few days before; thin ice can delay or cancel the event.

slides.title: Plan For An Early Start
slides.voice: Hwacheon is planned for January ninth to thirty-first, 2027. From Seoul, the bus takes about three hours.
slides.photo_query: Dong Seoul Bus Terminal intercity bus Hwacheon Korea

slides.title: See The Winter Lights
slides.sub: Visit Cheonggyecheon on a weekday evening
slides.voice: For lights without a long trip, walk Cheonggyecheon in Seoul. Go on a weekday evening to miss the biggest crowds.
